answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can trade, with the stake growing toward a summit of reputation earned over time. A new identity starts at the base, marked with a saffron flag visible to peers, and can only reach the zenith of full trading privileges after a long history of honest, verified work. An attacker spinning up thousands of fake agents must lock up a deposit for each one and wait out the same slow climb, so flooding the network costs far more than it can earn.
